create_trainer: create a Trainer or SingleTrainer instance to manage multi-task transformer model training
run_mlm_step: run masked language modeling step to predict masked words in transformer encoder
run_clm_step: run causal language modeling step for next-word prediction in transformer decoder
run_mt_step: run machine translation step with encoder-decoder architecture for cross-lingual generation
save_checkpoint: save model weights, optimizer state, and training metrics to a checkpoint file
